description.value: A municipally operated heated outdoor pool in Kensington Park, Burnaby, open year-round with a covered and heated deck area for fall and winter swimming. The 6-lane pool includes a diving board, sauna, and change rooms with showers — a welcome stop for touring cyclists looking to cool off or warm up depending on the season.

address.value: 700 Hammarskjold Dr, Burnaby, BC V5B 3Z9, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a City of Burnaby municipal outdoor heated pool open year-round, located in Kensington Park.
